2607.18704.title: What the Waveform Knows: Transparent-first Speech and Audio Intelligence with Caption Studio
2607.18704.paper_summary: Caption Studio is a transparency-first speech and audio intelligence platform that transforms spoken audio and video into structured, searchable content through automated transcription, speaker diarization, speech analytics, signal-level audio analysis, and subtitle generation. The system is built on a FastAPI backend with a real-time dashboard and adopts a three-layer architecture comprising (i) a transcription and diarization core based on Whisper-class automatic speech recognition and pyannote speaker diarization, (ii) an audio intelligence layer that extracts acoustic and linguistic features, including waveforms, spectrograms, pitch, speaking rate, silence, filler-word frequency, and sentiment, directly from the audio signal, and (iii) an integration layer that supports data export and downstream workflow integration. A principal contribution of this work is the transparency-first framework, in which every reported metric is explicitly identified as measured, derived, or unavailable, thereby improving the traceability, interpretability, and reliability of speech analytics. The paper presents the system architecture, benchmarking methodology, explainability and uncertainty framework, and key considerations for enterprise-scale deployment.
2607.18704.paper_summary_zh: Caption Studio 是一個以透明為首的語音和音頻智能平台，通過自動轉錄、說話者區分、語音分析、信號級音頻分析和字幕生成，將口語音頻和視頻轉換為結構化、可搜索的內容。該系統基於 FastAPI 後端構建，具有實時儀表板，並採用三層架構，包括 (i) 基於 Whisper 類自動語音識別和 pyannote 說話者區分的轉錄和區分核心，(ii) 一個音頻智能層，直接從音頻信號中提取聲學和語言特徵，包括波形、頻譜圖、音調、說話速度、靜音、填充詞頻率和情感，以及 (iii) 一個支持數據導出和下游工作流程集成的整合層。這項工作的主要貢獻是透明優先框架，其中每個報告的指標明確標識為測量、衍生或不可用，從而提高了語音分析的可追溯性、可解釋性和可靠性。本文介紹了系統架構、基準測試方法、可解釋性和不確定性框架，以及企業級部署的關鍵考量。
